title: The Hostile Gate

artist_statement.text:
GIANT #The Hostile Gate


The most hostile gate is a refrigerator door. For someone waging a constant war of caloric deficits and a brutal 10% margin of error, this mundane appliance becomes a suffocating cage. You stand bathed in the hum, feeling the heavy pause before the lock clicks. The closed door represents absolute custody over your own body. To open it is to surrender control; to keep it closed is to remain trapped in the daily battle against primal hunger. The exit dynamic is pure survival.

This threshold image anchors my ongoing "GIANT" project (150+ works, initiated 2020). Exploring physicality and trauma, the series has won over 20 international honors, including the Global Peace Photo Award, and has been featured in 120+ exhibitions globally, securing places in prominent museum collections.

Technical note:

Year: 2020

Location: Mykolaiv, Ukraine

Shot on SONY ILCE-6000 with DT 16-80mm F3.5-4.5 ZA lens at 16mm.

Shutter Speed: 1/200 sec | Aperture: f/3.5 | ISO: 640

Date Created: 2020-04-16

Processed in Adobe Photoshop. Pure photographic capture; no AI generation or composite manipulation.
